channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Billy Hunter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Billy Hunter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michele Roberts on Billy Hunter
item.description:
“But the players know better. They run this union. That was the reason my predecessor [Billy Hunter] got fired, because on some level, they thought that he was he was unilaterally making decisions that affected them.”

Michele Roberts on Billy Hunter, Jul 8, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Derek Fisher on Billy Hunter
item.description:
“Players representatives in the general body of our association have made their voice and their votes heard. Today, the motion was raised, seconded and passed unanimously that we will terminate the employment of Billy Hunter.”

Derek Fisher on Billy Hunter, Feb 17, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Maurice Evans on Billy Hunter
item.description:
“But Derek has done a great job of being on the offensive and only pointing the finger at Mr. Hunter. (Derek) has been busy throwing darts and throwing dirt at (Hunter) that nobody has ever taken the time to stop and ask what is Derek’s motive. What really went on in Dallas that he left to go and say now all of sudden he has family issues, he misses his family?“Now all of sudden what really happened? We voted him out 8-0 as president and yet he still stayed on, didn’t blink twice and came back with Paul-Weiss, and now they’re running the union.”

Maurice Evans on Billy Hunter, Feb 16, 2013. Source: FOXSports.com.

item.title: Maurice Evans on Billy Hunter
item.description:
After nine NBA seasons — he played last year with the Wizards — the career-long role player couldn’t find a job this season, which meant his role in the union ended.

“Without a doubt, I know me not being in the league has something to do with my support of Billy Hunter,”

Maurice Evans on Billy Hunter, Feb 16, 2013. Source: FOXSports.com.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Billy Hunter
item.description:
“He's been in the league a long time and done a really good job representing us as the head player rep. I think it's a smart decision [to place Hunter on leave]. We didn't let him go; we just placed him on leave. Now we get a chance to sit down with no outside influences, just the players, and really discuss what we're going to do next. And I think Derek's going to do a really good job leading us in that direction.”

Andre Iguodala on Billy Hunter, Feb 2, 2013. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Arn Tellem on Billy Hunter
item.description:
“Hunter is betting that the players — historically passive — will let him slide. I hope you don’t. Clearly, Hunter has violated your trust.”

Arn Tellem on Billy Hunter, Jan 29, 2013. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Arn Tellem on Billy Hunter
item.description:
Tellem writes in the letter.

“I implore you and your fellow players to take control of your union and your future. It’s time for Mr. Hunter to go.”

Arn Tellem on Billy Hunter, Jan 29, 2013. Source: New York Times.

item.title: David Stern on Billy Hunter
item.description:
Stern:

“If I were a player, one of 450, I would wonder what it is Billy Hunter just did.”

David Stern on Billy Hunter, Nov 14, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kevin Martin on Billy Hunter
item.description:
“[Union leader Billy Hunter] knows what he is doing. We just need the players to stand behind him and trust that he wants us back on the court ASAP. We owe it to the fans.”

Kevin Martin on Billy Hunter, Nov 5, 2011. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Keyon Dooling on Billy Hunter
item.description:
“I think he's articulate enough to relay the message. I think he's tough enough to get his feet dirty, to get his hands dirty. He's on the ground level with us. It really pains me, because not only do I look at Derek as a leader, but I look at him as a mentor. To hear all the confusion and the things that's being written and said about him, and what it does for our fight and our cause, it does a lot of detriment. And that's not even the true internal battle. I don't think the battle is within our union ... I'm the first vice president. And I stand behind him, and I stand behind Mr. Hunter.”

Keyon Dooling on Billy Hunter, Nov 4, 2011. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jason Terry on Derek Fisher, Billy Hunter
item.description:
Art Garcia:Jason Terry on players:

“We're as strong as ever. It's only bec Billy Hunter & Derek Fisher have done a great job preparing us.”

Jason Terry on Derek Fisher, Billy Hunter, Oct 19, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: David Stern on Billy Hunter
item.description:
Pressed by interviewer David Aldridge, Stern said,

“How many times does it pay to keep meeting, and have the same things thrown back at you? We’re ready to sit down and make a deal, and I don’t think the union is. But hopefully on Tuesday, aided by the mediator, they’ll be ready to make a deal. And certainly, I’ll bring my owners ready to make a deal. Unlike Billy Hunter, you’ve never heard me say something is a 'blood issue.'”

David Stern on Billy Hunter, Oct 14, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Zach Randolph on Billy Hunter
item.description:
“I sent a text to Billy Hunter two weeks ago and told him he has my full support,”

Zach Randolph on Billy Hunter, Sep 27, 2011. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: John Wall on Derek Fisher, Billy Hunter
item.description:
“I look at my e-mail 24-7. [National Basketball Players Association Executive Director] Billy Hunter writes me an e-mail, I’m checking it. [Players’ union President] Derek Fisher, I’m checking it. You just want to play. Most veteran guys, they take time off, they know how to get themselves ready for a season and stay in shape. Most young guys, we so anxious to play, we play wherever.”

John Wall on Derek Fisher, Billy Hunter, Sep 26, 2011. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Derek Fisher, Billy Hunter
item.description:
Durant added that he’s keeping a positive attitude and that the players trust the union leadership.

“I’m just trying to support [union president] Derek Fisher and [executive director] Billy Hunter and the players union and all those guys,”

Kevin Durant on Derek Fisher, Billy Hunter, Sep 20, 2011. Source: Washington Times.

item.title: Ben Gordon on Billy Hunter
item.description:
Ben Gordon:

“Judging from what he did with the last lockout, it seemed like the players were happy. I understand this negotiation is completely different. One thing I do know about Billy Hunter is he fights for the players. I feel like that’s exactly with what he’s doing right now. It seems like right now, the league is just saying 'take it or leave it.' I think you have to take a stance. At the end of the day, the owners have a lot at stake and so do the players. You have to stand and fight or take a deal you don’t want to take. That’s not something the players are willing to do.”

Ben Gordon on Billy Hunter, Aug 17, 2011. Source: Grantland.

item.title: Derek Fisher on Billy Hunter
item.description:
Derek Fisher on if he thinks the players will be locked out come July 1st:

“That’s not for me to say. A lockout is an owner-imposed lockout. That’s a decision that only they can make. For now, as President of the Players Association, my focus is on negotiating on the deal. That’s the part that I control over is myself, Billy [Hunter], our Executive Committee, and our player reps are focusing on negotiating the actual deal. If the owners decide they want to lock us out because we don’t agree to the most dramatic rollback in professional sports history, then that’s the choice that they have.”

Derek Fisher on Billy Hunter, Jun 22, 2011. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Carl Landry on Billy Hunter
item.description:
Carl Landry told Beyond the Beat.

“He (Hunter) forewarned us that there might be a lockout in effect, and he shared different ideas that will help prepare us for the lockout. They (players' association) are there for us and are already thinking about different contestants and things that will help the players.”

Carl Landry on Billy Hunter, Jan 26, 2011. Source: Beyond The Beat.
